anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question

## Today
Every download uses your saved column order.

## The change
You can pick a different column order for one download, and your saved order stays the same. The download already accepts a one-time order, so the change only connects the form's choice to it, with no second export path and nothing saved.

## What I checked
- Held: The download reads the saved order and accepts a one-time order, the download form already supports a one-download choice, and preferences save only when you explicitly save them.

The framing holds: checked the download, the download form, the preference saving, and every caller of the download.
Where should users choose the column order?
A) in the download form
B) in a separate preview
Recommendation: A - it keeps the choice next to the download.
